description_en: Changes the resource group to which an Elastic Block Storage (EBS) resource belongs
kebab_example: aliyun ebs change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type diskreplicapair --resource-id pair-123 --new-resource-group-id rg-123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

dedicatedblockstoragecluster: dedicated block storage cluster.
diskreplicapair: replication pair.
diskreplicagroup: replication pair-consistent group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：

dedicatedblockstoragecluster：专属块存储集群。
diskreplicapair：异步复制关系。
diskreplicagroup：一致性复制组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. For example, if you set ResourceType to diskreplicapair, set this parameter to the ID of a replication pair
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。例如，当ResourceType=diskreplicapair时，则ResourceId可以理解为异步复制对ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group. You can view the available resource groups in the Resource Management console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 新的企业资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用企业资源组。企业资源组详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
